title: A land first pass of a code item that ends not done yet with no merge to wait for leaves its run state at landing, which runs lists as drift and claim and stage-back read as a land still running
goal: land moves the run state of an item whose first pass ended not done yet with no pending merge request (a code branch gone and no merge found, or --wait-merge 0) to refused naming the step merge request, so no run state stays landing with no land running

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, types
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog, bl_land
r = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(r), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init", "-q")
(r / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items"}))
(r / "items").mkdir()
backlog.OUTPUT_ROOT[0] = str(r)
iid = "ST-aaaaaaaa"
bl_land.need = lambda bl, i: iid
bl_land.take_run(iid, "claimed", "claim")
bl_land.take_run(iid, "working", "dispatch")
bl_land.take_run(iid, "returned", "dispatch")
# the first pass of a code item ends not done yet and finds no merge request to wait for (the merge request merged and removed its branch)
def first_pass(bl, a):
    bl_land.LAND_OPS["pending"] = None
    return 0
bl_land.land_pass = first_pass
bl_land.land_move_run(types.SimpleNamespace(root=str(r)), types.SimpleNamespace(id=iid, wait_merge=1800))
state = bl_land.run_state(iid)
print("run state after a first pass that ended not done yet:", repr(state))
sys.exit(0 if state != "landing" else 1)
